title: FAST-MVP acceptance battery: executable retrieval/counter-authority falsification benchmark + multilingual/provenance test reuse + standing-pin re-hash + ordered-item adjudication on the unchanged accepted pins
fast_mvp_directive: FAST MVP MODE (factory direction v63 evaluation dispatch): build the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority benchmark that can falsify the product; reuse existing multilingual/provenance tests; do not rerun obsolete universal-174k benchmarks.
why_this_cycle: The smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority falsification benchmark already exists and is accepted (evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark.py wrapping evaluation/mapping_free_recall_falsifier.run(); falsification of the packet-of-record v3 bytes accepted at runs 39852758814 and 39854748616, re-confirmed at 39873360672). The v63 ordered items were adjudicated NOT_TRIGGERED / STANDING at the accepted tip while the accepted product head stays fe219a19. What this cycle adds is one consolidated, freeze-first EXECUTABLE acceptance battery under a new run id: (a) execute the accepted benchmark against the unchanged pins and publish this run's record; (b) execute the existing multilingual/provenance/benchmark test suites (the reuse-first battery named in the lane directive) under the lane shim; (c) re-hash every standing frozen pin before and after; (d) machine-adjudicate ordered items (1)-(5) from committed conditions instead of prose. This cycle builds NO new threshold, gate, rubric, bar or verdict contract, reads no frozen rubric for enforcement (re-hash only), reruns NO universal-174k benchmark, and never patches product code.
pre_freeze_disclosure: Reconnaissance preceded this freeze and is disclosed verbatim so no reader mistakes this run for a blind confirmation. WHAT WAS OBSERVED BEFORE THIS FREEZE: (1) every outcome this battery reproduces is already ACCEPTED EVIDENCE: the mapping-free falsification on the v3 bytes (accepted runs 39852758814, 39854748616, re-confirmed 39873360672, verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED with failed gates mf::concept_coverage::39319405429::de-kapitalverletzung plus mf::counter_authority_surface on de/fr/it), the frozen-bar digests (4457e971/a7452748/b9cdb894) as stated in the v63 question, and the accepted product mount head fe219a19 / planner pin 9764a37e as pinned by the accepted state; (2) A PRIOR SESSION OF THIS SAME GitHub run (39884405570, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=1, wrapper re-exec LEX_WRAPPER_REEXEC=1) executed the benchmark at 2026-10-23T01:34:55Z under the non-GitHub id local_eval_1792719295, writing uncommitted artifacts results/evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark/local_eval_1792719295.json, results/evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark/local_eval_1792719295_engine_mapping_free_recall_falsifier.json and reports/evaluation/RETRIEVAL_CA_BENCHMARK_local_eval_1792719295.md with verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED exit_code 1, n_gates 18, n_failed 4, product_mount_head fe219a19, direction_version 61 (the wrapper's own frozen instrument field); those artifacts are PRESERVED VERBATIM, committed with this cycle, disclosed here, and are NOT this run's claim-bearing record - the claim-bearing record is results/evaluation/fast_mvp_acceptance/39884405570.json plus results/evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark/39884405570.json; (3) the expected standing-pin digests below are TRANSCRIBED from accepted artifacts (the frozen bars' digests from the v63 question text, the packet.json digest from the v63 mission, bundle digests from accepted state benchmark_result.v3_bundle_shas) and each was re-hashed from disk at freeze time before this hypothesis was committed - transcription, not re-derivation. No benchmark, battery or adjudication claim-bearing execution had produced an artifact under run id 39884405570 at the moment of this freeze.
hypothesis: (H1) The accepted FAST-MVP benchmark executed under --run-id 39884405570 on the unchanged pins exits 1 with verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED, run_valid=true, empty input_drift, exactly the four accepted failed gates (mf::concept_coverage::39319405429::de-kapitalverletzung; mf::counter_authority_surface::39319405429::de-kapitalverletzung; ::fr-bail-entretien; ::it-responsabilita-medica) out of 18 gates, and non_vacuity.all_hold=true; a different failed-gate set, a vacuous run, a drift invalidation or an exit 0 are all reported as the cycle result in full (exit 0 would itself be a NEGATIVE reproduction finding - the accepted falsification would not reproduce). (H2) Every standing pin re-hashes identical before and after execution (frozen bars RULES_LABEL/RULES_GEOMETRY/VERDICT_CONTRACT, frozen retrieval benchmark, the two mapping-free freeze records, the mapping-free hypothesis, the vendored serve verdict, product planner, product mount head, packet.json, the three v3 bundle files); any mismatch is PINS_DRIFTED_VACUOUS (exit 2), never a pass. (H3) The seven-suite reuse battery (test_minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark, test_mapping_free_recall_falsifier, test_stand_ready_multilingual_probe, test_mount_provenance_gate, test_disclosure_provenance_crosscheck, test_boilerplate_resistance_real, test_offline_emission_path_benchmark) executed under evaluation/no_pytest_runner.py returns verdict SHIM_PASS with n_failed=0 and n_absent=0; UNSUPPORTED constructs are counted as NOT-RUN and are never reported as passed, and a SHIM_PASS never withdraws the standing disclosure that pytest is absent from the producer image. (H4) The ordered-item adjudication computed from committed machine conditions reads: (1) NOT_TRIGGERED iff product planner sha256 equals the already-re-frozen pin 9764a37e8bc7c8c31a329ba15db89657e8ee47dde8ada924fa55d5e755fd06a9; (2) NOT_TRIGGERED iff the accepted product mount head equals fe219a197e4bfb129984a732ab9adca917556eac; (3) STANDING_OK iff the standing pins re-hash match; (4) STANDING_OK recorded as a carry-forward reference to the accepted P1 FR counter-stage divergence in state/evaluation.json, explicitly NOT re-derived here; (5) NOT_TRIGGERED iff neither the mount's results/product/frontier_verdicts nor evaluation/vendored_frontier_serve_audit carries an accepted serve_recommendation that supersedes the DO-NOT-SERVE orders. Any adjudication that reads TRIGGERED is this cycle's honest finding and is published as such.
success_rule: All of H1-H4 hold for run 39884405570. Every component is published together: benchmark exit/verdict/failed gates/non-vacuity, battery per-file pass/fail/skip/unsupported counts, before/after pin digests with drift list (empty required), ordered-item adjudication with the machine condition each verdict was derived from, and wall-clock seconds per step (REPORTED-ONLY latency, no threshold). A partial success is reported component-by-component; nothing failing is dropped.

exit_codes.0: BATTERY_EXECUTED_PINS_HELD - all steps executed, pins identical before/after, battery SHIM_PASS; the embedded benchmark verdict is published verbatim and its falsification_proven is a reported field, not this exit code
exit_codes.1: BATTERY_INCOMPLETE - a step failed to execute (benchmark crash, battery SHIM_FAIL/absent file, unreadable record); fail-closed, never a product verdict
exit_codes.2: PINS_DRIFTED_VACUOUS - any frozen or accepted pin re-hash mismatched before/after execution; run invalidated, never a pass, never a bar-met

baseline: The accepted measurement being reproduced under a new run id: results/evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark/39873360672.json (verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED, exit 1, n_gates 18, n_failed 4, run_valid true) and its accepted predecessors 39854748616/39852758814. Reproduction means identity of verdict, failed-gate set, run validity and non-vacuity, not a new ranking of the product.
claim_ceiling: This cycle establishes exactly three things: (a) the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority falsification benchmark still executes end-to-end under this run's environment on the unchanged accepted pins and (conditionally on H1) reproduces the accepted falsification of the packet-of-record v3 bytes; (b) the lane's multilingual/provenance/benchmark test battery is executable and green (or honestly not-green) under the disclosed shim; (c) the standing frozen pins and the ordered-item trigger conditions hold as machine-checked. It does NOT meet, move or re-derive the frozen absolute LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND bars (they stay REPORTED-ONLY); it does NOT lift, weaken or supersede either DO-NOT-SERVE order; it does NOT certify packet admission (admission stays fail-closed); it does NOT claim the map helps a jurist (human product gate); it does NOT make the comparative map-versus-ranked-list question non-vacuous (n_emitted on the live path stays the deciding measure); it does NOT re-score any Frontier candidate; it runs NO obsolete universal-174k benchmark; it adds NO threshold, gate, rubric or verdict contract; human_gate_ready stays false; owner_decision_required stays false.
